project_metadata.name: CallBridge
project_metadata.summary: Autonomous outbound phone-negotiation agent that places calls on behalf of a human client, intercepts constraint violations in real time, stalls the receptionist with a natural holding phrase, escalates a Red Decision Card to the human, and speaks an approved counter-offer back — all through a FastAPI backend with WebSocket and REST interfaces.

project_description.primary_purpose: CallBridge solves the problem of high-stakes, constraint-bound phone negotiations that humans find stressful or error-prone — such as booking medical appointments under time and budget limits, placing food orders with specific restrictions, or negotiating service terms. The system acts as a fully autonomous AI caller: it accepts a natural-language goal from the user, parses it into a structured rule-set (budgets, time windows, forbidden disclosures), and conducts the entire outbound conversation on the user's behalf. The real-world value is that it eliminates the cognitive load of live negotiation while guaranteeing that user-defined hard limits are never breached without explicit human sign-off.
project_description.architecture_and_control_flow: Requests enter through a FastAPI server (app.py) which maintains an in-memory session store (sessiondb). On session creation, the user's raw prompt is forwarded to engine.extract_rules_from_prompt(), which calls the Groq LLM with a structured system prompt and json_object response format to produce an ExtractedRules Pydantic model. During the call, each receptionist utterance arrives either as text via POST /evaluate-turn or as raw audio via POST /audio-turn — the audio path first passes through engine.transcribe_audio() (AssemblyAI primary, Groq Whisper fallback) before joining the same evaluation path. engine.evaluate_caller_turn() then builds a context window from the last 8 transcript turns plus the decision ledger and sends it to the LLM, which returns a TurnDecision. Depending on that decision, the session transitions to IN_PROGRESS (safe reply), DECISION_REQUIRED (dealbreaker), or COMPLETED (call confirmed). A parallel WebSocket endpoint (/ws/call/{session_id}) mirrors the full state machine for streaming frontends using named JSON events.
project_description.edge_cases_and_invariants: The most critical invariant is the dealbreaker interception: if the LLM sets is_dealbreaker=true, the session is immediately frozen at DECISION_REQUIRED and a stalling phrase is returned for the agent to speak aloud — the call cannot proceed until the human explicitly approves a counter-action via /user-action followed by /approve. An approved override is appended to the decision_ledger, and the LLM is explicitly instructed to treat ledger entries as authoritative — preventing previously approved alternatives from being re-flagged as violations. Audio transcription failures degrade gracefully: AssemblyAI errors are caught and logged, falling back to Groq Whisper; if both fail the endpoint returns a 500 with a structured error body rather than silently dropping the turn. TTS playback failures in tts_player.py are swallowed entirely (bare except pass) so a speaker driver issue never crashes the client. Empty or silent audio turns return a canned 'couldn't hear you' draft response without invoking the LLM, avoiding wasted inference on empty input.

hardware_requirements.notes: CPU-only. Requires microphone and speakers for the interactive test client. Windows assumed for TTS playback via PowerShell MediaPlayer.

cli_flags_or_routes.description: Parses the user's natural-language prompt and creates a negotiation session with extracted rules.
Returns current session state, mode, pending draft, and decision ledger.
Submits a text turn from the receptionist; returns TurnDecision (dealbreaker or draft reply).
Submits raw audio (multipart/form-data); transcribes via AssemblyAI then evaluates the turn.
Records the human client's chosen counter-action and stages a bilingual draft response.
Approves the pending staged draft for speaking; clears the pending draft and resumes IN_PROGRESS.
Finalises the call and generates the post-call audit summary report.
Lists available models from the configured Groq endpoint.
Real-time bidirectional call channel: TRANSCRIPTION_CHUNK / USER_ACTION / APPROVE_AND_SPEAK / END_CALL in; SPEAK_PHRASE / DECISION_REQUIRED / STAGING_UPDATE / CALL_SUMMARY out.

entrypoint_and_execution.lifecycle_summary: On startup, FastAPI registers all routes and CORS middleware. A client POSTs to /api/session/create with a natural-language prompt; engine.extract_rules_from_prompt() calls the Groq LLM to produce an ExtractedRules object stored in sessiondb. During the call, each receptionist utterance is evaluated by engine.evaluate_caller_turn() which returns a TurnDecision. Dealbreakers freeze the session at DECISION_REQUIRED; the human picks a counter-action via /user-action, engine.generate_staged_draft() produces a bilingual response, and /approve resumes the call. At call end, /complete calls engine.generate_call_summary() for a structured audit report.

environment_and_secrets.description: API key for the Groq inference endpoint. Missing key raises ValueError at import time in engine.py.
Model identifier passed to Groq for all chat completions. Defaults to 'openai/gpt-oss-20b' via get_model().
API key for AssemblyAI speech-to-text. When absent, transcribe_audio() falls back to Groq Whisper (whisper-large-v3-turbo).

execution_flow.name: Session Creation & Rule Extraction
execution_flow.input_contract: JSON body: { raw_prompt: str, user_language: str = 'English', mode: str = 'delegate' | 'assist' }
execution_flow.output_contract: JSON: { status, session_id, flags: {is_configured, status, mode}, extracted_rules: ExtractedRules }
execution_flow.mechanism: Validates the raw prompt is non-empty, generates a UUID session ID (8 chars), calls engine.extract_rules_from_prompt() to parse constraints via LLM, then stores the full session dict in sessiondb.

execution_flow.name: LLM Goal Parsing
execution_flow.input_contract: Natural-language instruction string + user's preferred language
execution_flow.output_contract: ExtractedRules: { intent, target_business, action_details, opening_phrase, constraints: List[RuleConstraint], forbidden_disclosures, special_notes }
execution_flow.mechanism: Builds a structured system prompt and calls client.chat.completions.create() with response_format={'type': 'json_object'} at temperature=0.1. Parses the returned JSON and validates through the ExtractedRules Pydantic model.

execution_flow.name: Receptionist Turn Evaluation
execution_flow.input_contract: Receptionist speech string + full session dict (rules, transcript_history, decision_ledger, mode)
execution_flow.output_contract: TurnDecision: { is_dealbreaker, call_completed, violation_parameter, violation_reason, immediate_stalling_phrase, suggested_user_options: List[str], draft_response }
execution_flow.mechanism: Assembles a context-rich system prompt including the last 8 history turns, decision ledger of approved overrides, constraint rules, and ASSIST-mode addendum if active. Calls Groq at temperature=0.1 with json_object response format.

execution_flow.name: Audio Transcription
execution_flow.input_contract: bytes | file-like object | file path for WAV/MP3 audio; filename string for MIME hint
execution_flow.mechanism: Primary path: AssemblyAI Transcriber (if ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY is set). Fallback: Groq Whisper via client.audio.transcriptions.create() using model='whisper-large-v3-turbo'. Result feeds into evaluate_caller_turn().

execution_flow.name: Dealbreaker Escalation & Staged Draft
execution_flow.input_contract: Session dict (rules, language) + UserDecisionAction { chosen_action, custom_instruction }
execution_flow.mechanism: When TurnDecision.is_dealbreaker=True the session enters DECISION_REQUIRED. The human picks an option; generate_staged_draft() sends it to the LLM which produces a bilingual polite counter-offer. The english_response is stored as pending_draft and a ledger entry is appended.

execution_flow.name: Approval & TTS Playback
execution_flow.input_contract: Session must be in AWAITING_APPROVAL state with a non-null pending_draft
execution_flow.output_contract: REST: { status: 'APPROVED', speak_text }. Audio: MP3 synthesised via edge-tts and played via Windows PowerShell MediaPlayer.
execution_flow.mechanism: POST /approve clears pending_draft, appends agent turn to transcript_history, sets status to IN_PROGRESS, and returns speak_text. The test client calls speak_text_aloud() which synthesises with edge_tts.Communicate, saves a temp MP3, and plays it via a PowerShell subprocess blocking until playback completes.

code_anchor.snippet:
communicate = edge_tts.Communicate(text, voice)
await communicate.save(temp_file)
await asyncio.to_thread(play_audio_file, temp_file)

execution_flow.name: Post-Call Audit Summary
execution_flow.input_contract: Full session dict with transcript_history, decision_ledger, and rules
execution_flow.output_contract: FinalSummary: { outcome_headline, outcome_subtext, confirmed_items: List[str], unresolved_items: List[str] }
execution_flow.mechanism: Formats the complete conversation as a plain-text block and sends it with task constraints and ledger to the LLM at temperature=0.1. The model extracts confirmed agreements, open items, and produces an executive headline.

fields.name: raw_prompt
fields.description: Natural-language goal description from the human client.

fields.name: user_language
fields.description: Preferred language for translated responses. Defaults to 'English'.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: 'delegate' — AI negotiates autonomously; 'assist' — pauses for human approval on every commitment.

fields.name: intent
fields.description: Primary action, e.g. 'schedule_appointment'.

fields.name: target_business
fields.description: Business being called, e.g. 'Dr. Smith Dental Clinic'.

fields.name: action_details
fields.description: Specifics of the request.

fields.name: opening_phrase
fields.description: Natural first sentence CallBridge speaks when the receptionist picks up.

fields.name: constraints
fields.description: Parsed budget/time/quantity limits with parameter, operator, value, and unit.

fields.name: forbidden_disclosures
fields.description: Information the agent must never share (credit card, SSN, etc.).

fields.name: special_notes
fields.description: Additional freeform notes from the user's prompt.

fields.name: is_dealbreaker
fields.description: True when the receptionist violates a constraint or requests forbidden data.

fields.name: call_completed
fields.description: True when the booking/order is confirmed or call ends.

fields.name: violation_parameter
fields.description: The violated constraint name, e.g. 'price'.

fields.name: violation_reason
fields.description: Human-readable Red Card reason.

fields.name: immediate_stalling_phrase
fields.description: Phrase spoken immediately to keep receptionist waiting.

fields.name: suggested_user_options
fields.description: 2-4 actionable choices surfaced on the Human-in-the-Loop UI card.

fields.name: draft_response
fields.description: Next agent utterance (safe turn) or initial counter-offer text (dealbreaker).

fields.name: english_response
fields.description: Exact English phrase agent will speak after approval.

fields.name: translated_response
fields.description: Same phrase in the user's preferred language for verification.

fields.name: action_summary
fields.description: One-line ledger entry, e.g. 'Counter-offer drafted for Sunday appointment'.

fields.name: outcome_headline
fields.description: Bold executive headline of call result.

fields.name: outcome_subtext
fields.description: One-sentence logistics/payment status description.

fields.name: confirmed_items
fields.description: Facts explicitly agreed upon during the conversation.

fields.name: unresolved_items
fields.description: Open questions or ambiguities the call did not resolve.

fields.name: chosen_action
fields.description: Option selected by the human from the Red Decision Card.

fields.name: custom_instruction
fields.description: Free-text instruction if the user chose 'Type my own response'.

endpoints_or_interfaces.details: Parses raw_prompt via LLM into ExtractedRules; stores new session in sessiondb; returns session_id and extracted_rules.
Returns status (READY_TO_START | IN_PROGRESS | DECISION_REQUIRED | AWAITING_APPROVAL | COMPLETED), pending_draft, and decision_ledger.
Body: IncomingCallerTurn { caller_text }. Returns TurnDecision and new session status.
Multipart form-data with 'file' field. Transcribes via AssemblyAI (Groq Whisper fallback), then evaluates.
Body: UserDecisionAction. Calls generate_staged_draft(); sets status to AWAITING_APPROVAL; appends ledger entry.

endpoints_or_interfaces.summary: Approve staged draft and resume call
endpoints_or_interfaces.details: Clears pending_draft, appends agent turn to transcript, sets status to IN_PROGRESS. Returns speak_text for TTS.

endpoints_or_interfaces.summary: End call and generate audit report
endpoints_or_interfaces.details: Sets status=COMPLETED; calls generate_call_summary(). Returns FinalSummary.
Calls client.models.list() and returns array of model IDs.
Inbound: TRANSCRIPTION_CHUNK, USER_ACTION, APPROVE_AND_SPEAK, END_CALL. Outbound: SPEAK_PHRASE, DECISION_REQUIRED, STAGING_UPDATE, CALL_SUMMARY.

file_system_directory.purpose: All application source lives flat in the project root — no subdirectory layering.

key_files.role: FastAPI application — route handlers, session state machine, CORS middleware
LLM orchestration — Groq client, all prompt-building and inference calls, AssemblyAI + Whisper transcription
Pydantic v2 data models for all request/response contracts
Edge TTS synthesis and PowerShell-based audio playback
Interactive CLI test harness — mic recording, HTTP orchestration, human-in-the-loop decision prompts
Standalone debug script to enumerate available Groq models
